system.description:
Advantage on checks to forge, impersonate, or maintain a disguise under scrutiny, and Advantage on the first Deception check made in any encounter. You can put together a convincing disguise in 1 minute, and once per day you may reroll a failed check to maintain a disguise or deception.

Available to: Rogues, Assassins, Rangers, Monks, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, and Artificers.

rules.when: to forge, impersonate or maintain a disguise under scrutiny
first Deception check in an encounter
